customSections.content: A few RCPS dates have different schedules by school level.

groups.label: Early dismissal
items: On districtwide three-hour early-dismissal days, elementary schools dismiss at 11:25 a.m. and secondary schools at 12:25 p.m.
On May 25–26, early dismissal applies only to secondary students, at 12:25 p.m.

groups.label: High school virtual learning
items: The district calendar lists March 16–17 as virtual-learning days for high school students only.

groups.label: Graduation
items: Graduation ceremonies are scheduled May 25–26 at 2:30 p.m. and 5:30 p.m. Families should confirm each high school’s ceremony assignment.

customSections.label: Make-Up Days & Weather Changes
customSections.content: RCPS publishes the order it will use if weather or another closure requires additional instructional time.

groups.label: Published make-up order
items: The first five missed days use banked days.
The sixth missed day uses January 4, the seventh uses February 8, and the eighth uses March 12.
The ninth missed day is marked “Not Required.” For 10 or more missed days, RCPS may add time to the school day.

groups.label: Before making plans
items: Check RCPS announcements before treating January 4, February 8, or March 12 as a guaranteed day off.

customSections.label: What Changed From 2025–26

calendarFaqs.q: Is this the official RCPS calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: MySchoolDates is an independent reference based on the calendar page and PDF published by Roanoke County Public Schools. The current PDF remains labeled DRAFT — SUBJECT TO CHANGE, so RCPS is the source of record for revisions.

Yes. RCPS uses banked days for the first five missed days. The published order then uses January 4 for the sixth day, February 8 for the seventh, and March 12 for the eighth. For 10 or more missed days, RCPS may add time to the school day.

calendarFaqs.q: Does RCPS have school on Veterans Day?
calendarFaqs.a: The current 2026–27 RCPS calendar does not list Veterans Day as a school closure, so November 11 is scheduled as a regular school day unless the district announces a change.

Teacher workdays are August 3–7 and August 10–12, 2026, before students begin. The calendar also lists October 12, January 4, March 12, and May 28 as teacher workdays; January 4 and March 12 may be converted under the make-up schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: What time do students leave on RCPS early-dismissal days?
calendarFaqs.a: On districtwide three-hour early-dismissal days, elementary schools dismiss at 11:25 a.m. and secondary schools at 12:25 p.m. On May 25–26, early dismissal applies only to secondary students, at 12:25 p.m.

calendarFaqs.q: When do RCPS students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return Tuesday, January 5, 2027. Monday, January 4 is a teacher workday and may be converted if RCPS needs its sixth make-up day.

calendarFaqs.q: Are March 16–17 virtual-learning days for all RCPS students?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The official calendar lists March 16–17, 2027 as virtual-learning days for high school students only.

calendarFaqs.q: When are RCPS graduation ceremonies in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: RCPS lists graduation ceremonies on May 25–26, 2027, at 2:30 p.m. and 5:30 p.m. Secondary students dismiss at 12:25 p.m. on both days; families should confirm each school’s ceremony assignment.
